comparisons.peer_summary: As of December 2024, aggregate credit exposure decreased slightly from December 2023 due to lower cash deposits with central banks, partially offset by an increase in loans and lending commitments. The percentage of exposure from non-investment-grade counterparties increased, primarily due to the decrease in investment-grade central bank deposits.
comparisons.comparison: Both Citi and Goldman Sachs disclose that their aggregate credit exposure is predominantly investment grade, though they quantify this differently. Citi reports that approximately 78% of its total CRE exposure was rated investment grade as of December 31, 2024. Similarly, Goldman Sachs notes that the percentage of non-investment-grade credit exposures increased relative to the prior year primarily because investment-grade cash deposits with central banks decreased, implying the majority of its credit exposure remains investment grade. Unlike Citi, which isolates CRE ratings, GS discusses the composition of total aggregate credit exposure.

sentences.text: In addition, as of December 31, 2024, approximately 78% of Citi's total CRE exposure was rated investment grade and more than 75% was to borrowers in the U.S (compared to approximately 80% rated investment grade and more than 77% to borrowers in the U.S. as of December 31, 2023).

As of December 2024, our aggregate credit exposure decreased slightly compared with December 2023, primarily reflecting a decrease in cash deposits with central banks, partially offset by an increase in loans and lending commitments.

The percentage of our credit exposures arising from non-investment-grade counterparties (based on our internally determined public rating agency equivalents) increased compared with December 2023, primarily reflecting a decrease in investment-grade credit exposure related to cash deposits with central banks.

comparisons.peer_topic: Real Estate Exposure Security and Counterparty Quality
comparisons.peer_summary: Real Estate exposure is approximately 84% secured; unsecured exposure is largely investment-grade primarily to Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs) and Real Estate Operating Companies (REOCs) with generally diversified underlying assets.
comparisons.comparison: Both disclosures focus specifically on Commercial Real Estate (CRE) exposure quality, but highlight different risk mitigation factors. Citi emphasizes the credit rating profile, stating 78% of its CRE exposure was rated investment grade. JPMorgan emphasizes collateralization and borrower type for its Real Estate exposure, noting it is approximately 84% secured with unsecured exposure being largely investment-grade REITs and REOCs. While both indicate high-quality exposure profiles, Citi provides a specific percentage of investment-grade ratings for CRE, whereas JPM provides a security/underlying asset quality breakdown for the broader Real Estate portfolio.

sentences.text: In addition, as of December 31, 2024, approximately 78% of Citi's total CRE exposure was rated investment grade and more than 75% was to borrowers in the U.S (compared to approximately 80% rated investment grade and more than 77% to borrowers in the U.S. as of December 31, 2023).

(c)Real Estate exposure is approximately 84% secured; unsecured exposure is largely investment-grade primarily to Real Estate Investment Trusts ("REITs") and Real Estate Operating Companies ("REOCs") whose underlying assets are generally diversified.

comparisons.peer_topic: Institutional Securities Lending Portfolio Composition and Credit Quality
comparisons.peer_summary: As of December 31, 2024, over 90% of the Institutional Securities segment's total lending exposure consisted of investment grade and/or secured loans and commitments. The portfolio includes corporate lending, secured facilities, commercial and residential real estate, and securities-based lending.
comparisons.comparison: Both disclosures report that a significant majority of their respective real estate/lending exposures are of high credit quality. Citi states that approximately 78% of its total CRE exposure was rated investment grade. Morgan Stanley reports that over 90% of its total lending exposure (which includes commercial and residential real estate) was investment grade and/or secured by collateral. Both firms demonstrate high credit quality in their real estate-related portfolios, though MS aggregates real estate with other lending types and includes security status in its high-quality definition.

sentences.text: In addition, as of December 31, 2024, approximately 78% of Citi's total CRE exposure was rated investment grade and more than 75% was to borrowers in the U.S (compared to approximately 80% rated investment grade and more than 77% to borrowers in the U.S. as of December 31, 2023).
As of December 31, 2024 and December 31, 2023, over 90% of our total lending exposure, which consists of loans and lending commitments, was investment grade and/or secured by collateral.
